brief: Quaternion Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces: Existence and Uniqueness Conditions — The existence and uniqueness conditions of quater- nion reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (QRKHS) are established
extended:
**Quaternion Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces: Existence and Uniqueness Conditions**

*Felipe A. Tobar and Danilo P. Mandic, Fellow, IEEE*

14 pp, 26 sections.

**Abstract.** The existence and uniqueness conditions of quater- nion reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (QRKHS) are established in order to provide a mathematical foundation for the develop- ment of quaternion-valued kernel learning algorithms. This is achieved through a rigorous account of left quaternion Hilbert spaces, which makes it possible to generalise standard RKHS to quaternion RKHS. Quaternion versions of the Riesz repre- sentation and Moore–Aronszajn theorems are next introduced, thus underpinning kernel estimation algorithms operating on quaternion-valued feature spaces. The difference between the proposed quaternion kernel concept and the existing real and vector approaches is also established in terms of both theoretical advantages and computational complexity.

**Outline.** Front matter; I INTRODUCTION; S INCE; II QUATERNION VECTOR SPACES; A The Quaternion Division Ring; B Quaternion-Valued Hilbert Spaces; III QUATERNION REPRODUCING KERNEL; A Riesz Representation Theorem; B Moore-Aronszajn Theorem; IV COMPARISON TO OTHER; A Vector-Valued RKHS (Matrix-Valued Kernels); B Multikernel Learning; C Quaternion Kernels; D Connections Between High-Dimensional Kernels; E Computational Complexity; V DESIGN OF QUATERNION-VALUED MERCER KERNELS; A Polynomial Kernel: The Quaternion Cubic Exam; B Real-Valued Gaussian Kernel
